name: cli-anything-wps
display_name: 兰台智报 · WPS 数据报表能力
description: 兰台智报的 WPS 表格数据报表能力：CSV 数据源一键生成带汇总公式、区域格式、图表插图的报表，并导出 XLSX/PDF。Command-line control for WPS Office via COM automation, with a data-reporting focus (Calc). Windows-only, requires WPS Office 12.0+ and pywin32.
requires: Python >= 3.10, Windows, WPS Office 12.0+, pywin32>=305, matplotlib, openpyxl
